content: To see the effect of semi-supervised learning alone, we also conduct experiments by setting INLINEFORM0 to eliminate the effect of feature adaptation. Both entropy minimization and bootstrapping perform very badly in this setting. Entropy minimization gives almost random predictions with accuracy below 0.4, and the results of bootstrapping are also much lower compared to NaiveNN. This suggests that the feature adaptation component is essential. Without it, the learned target representations are less meaningful and discriminative. Applying semi-supervised learning in this case is likely to worsen the results.
